# Get started

Carbon charts help you tell accurate and convincing stories around data with
beautiful and accessible visualizations.

**Note:** Please direct all questions regarding support, bug fixes, and feature
requests to the
[Carbon Charts core team](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-charts#core-team).

## Resources

### Getting started tutorials

We have written step-by-step tutorials on how to get simple charting
applications setup in different environment and using different frameworks.

- [vanilla](https://carbon-design-system.github.io/carbon-charts/?path=/story/docs-getting-started--vanilla)

- [React](https://carbon-design-system.github.io/carbon-charts/?path=/story/docs-getting-started--react)

- [Angular](https://carbon-design-system.github.io/carbon-charts/?path=/story/docs-getting-started--angular)

- [Vue](https://carbon-design-system.github.io/carbon-charts/?path=/story/docs-getting-started--vue)
